title: Mastering the Golden Ratio in UI
summary: This lesson demonstrates how to apply the golden ratio (1.618) to spacing, layout, and typography to create visual harmony. By using this mathematical constant, designers can replace random values with a structured rhythm used by leading tech brands like Apple and Stripe.

transcript.text: Applied to spacing. Start with 8 pixels.
Every gap follows this natural scale. Random padding becomes rhythm.
Now layout. Split your screen at 61.8 to 38.2.
Content on the large side, actions on the small side.
This is why Apple product pages feel so effortless.
Stripe, Linear, Airbnb. They all use this exact scale.
Follow for more design rules. Save this for your next project.

on_screen_text: Save this for your next project
before_after: A comparison between 'Random' padding and 'Golden' spacing based on the 1.618 multiplier.
